div.div: Reading path ① Messages arrive on Ethernet, CAN and LIN. ② The TSN switch schedules them against precision time. ③ The service router forwards them across the crossbar. ④ They become switched power at the smart fuses. ⑤ A lockstep mismatch drives the safe state. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
